entries.name: Artifact Publisher
entries.description: Public artifact delivery with restricted upload and administration.
entries.privateNotes: uploads.mauroner.eu is the intended stable URL but DNS was unresolved during planning. Keep checks paused and do not advertise it as live until DNS and Access are verified.

entries.name: Field Guide Console
entries.description: Restricted review and approval console. No stable link is published yet.
entries.privateNotes: Add a restricted link and monitor only after its stable deployment URL is confirmed.

entries.name: Tools Status & Directory
entries.description: The public catalog and five-minute status snapshots at tools.mauroner.net.
entries.privateNotes: Intentionally has no self-monitor. A five-minute origin probe would prevent Railway Serverless from sleeping.

entries.name: Network Console
entries.description: Restricted Tailscale network and port-service console.
entries.privateNotes: Railway has no Tailnet route; status must remain unavailable_from_railway rather than down.
